I can accept not retroactively prosecuting people for participating in abortion while it was legal.

But if abortion is abolished, mothers who murder their unborn children should be held accountable.
I just think it should be on each person to choose don't or do why do other people have to have a say in your health don't believe just don't get one

Abolishing abortion and changing the culture should later result in prosecutions of those who *knowingly* commit homicide against their children in utero. Yes, I can definitely see how right now that’s not feasible as many women who get abortions genuinely fall for “it’s just a clump of cells that isn’t even alive” line and don’t know - or at least claim not to know, and honestly that’s debatable - but once everyone knows that a fetus is most definitely alive, and if the mother of that fetus is a human than the fetus too is a human, any mother who murders her child should be held criminally culpable. If we sent a woman to jail for putting her baby in the microwave (yes that really happened), we should definitely then sentence that same woman for knowingly, intentionally having her baby dismembered.

The law is a great teacher, though. If abortion was criminalized, women would know it’s illegal to get abortions. So if they did get one, they would be knowingly breaking the law. I would argue that not wanting to break the law or face the consequences of breaking the law would greatly disincentivize women from getting abortions

I see the argument, but its largely founded on downplaying women as rational agents. "Oh they didn't know 😢😢" falls woefully short. We should not retroactively punish abortion once it is made legal, but this argumentation seems to justify continuing to treat women with kids gloves after such a ban.
So if a woman were to perform an abortion on herself, in say Texas, she should be… put to death? Because she “intentionally killed a human being”
Abortion is not murder. And it's not ANYONE'S CHOICE BUT THE PREGNANT PERSON'S ABOUT WHAT TO DO WITH IT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
To modify the late, mid, Charlie Kirk. 'putting a few women to death or having the maternal mortality rate skyrocket is a sacrifice we should be willing to make to ensure abortion remains illegal.'
Uhh no, abortion should be prosecuted.
If you premeditate the intentional killing of a human being you should be punished.
